name: Asian Energy Services Limited

annual_report.business: Asian Energy Services Limited is an integrated energy and minerals services company with over three decades of experience across upstream oil & gas and mining value chains, providing seismic surveys, integrated field development, EPC, O&M, and enhanced oil recovery services.

capacity_or_capex.item: Purchase of property, plant and equipment including capital work in progress (from Oilmax Energy)

guidance_or_targets.statement: Management has indicated confidence in growing the standalone India services business by 30-40% in 2026-27 with improved margins
Targeted revenue of USD 60-65 Million from Kuiper
Merger with Oilmax Energy expected to be completed by September or October 2026, subject to regulatory clearances

key_risks: Environmental non-compliance could damage reputation and reduce long-term demand for coal
Growing number of seismic and integrated energy services providers may affect ability to secure new contracts
Operating across multiple jurisdictions exposes the Company to varying legal, regulatory and approval requirements

Geopolitical developments, including the ongoing situation in West Asia, weather-related disruptions, and the global shift toward renewable energy sources, pose operational and business continuity risks
Financial risks (details not fully provided in excerpts)
Supply chain risks (details not fully provided in excerpts)

latest_guidance.statement: Standalone business 2-3 year CAGR guided at 25-30% beyond FY27
FY29 PAT guidance of INR450-500 crores reaffirmed
Confident of achieving FY27 guidance for both Asian Energy Services and Kuiper
Targeting ~INR 3,000 crore revenue and ~INR 700 crore EBITDA by FY29/30
Oil & Gas production to increase 5x to ~10,000 BOE by FY29/30
